title: Dasypodius' Dictionarium Latinogermanicum (1535)
author: Petrus Dasypodius
institution: Herzog August Bibliothek Wolfenbüttel (transcribed and edited by Jonathan West)
notes: Transcription of the first edition of Dasypodius' dictionary (Strasbourg: Rihel, 1535, Strasbourg copy) with variant readings of the 1536 edition, in five TEI files (contents and preface, A-B, C-H, I-O, P-Z), revised 30 November 2012. Counts are ours from the TEI files: one dictionary, about 6,600 entries and about 179,000 words in the 1535 text, leaving out the 1536 variant readings (approximate). Last file modified 2012.
